name: FedEx Freight Hub - Conley GA (Atlanta, ATL)
type: Freight LTL hub service center (~304 doors, one of the largest)

fieldNotes.location: Roster address '4900 Welcome All Rd' and roster coordinates (33.620745, -84.525293) both pointed to a residential area in the College Park/Camp Creek area, NOT a freight facility. The correct FedEx Freight ATL break-bulk hub is in the Conley GA 30288 industrial district near Thurman Rd, centered approximately 33.6510, -84.3388. Confirmed by Street View (2025-02) showing fenced parking with a 3-story FedEx Freight office building and FedEx-branded tractors and trailers, and by satellite showing a long cross-dock building with hundreds of trailers.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Entire ~121-acre property is perimeter-fenced (chain-link visible in Street View around the visitor parking and trailer yard). The truck yard is gated and separated from the front parking by an internal fence line; FedEx Freight break-bulk hubs are universally guard-controlled. Exact truck gate position inferred from the access corridor on the north side near the office; not directly Street-View confirmed because all panos are inside the visitor parking.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Not directly visible in available imagery (panos are inside the fenced parking lot). FedEx Freight hubs of this scale (~304 doors, a network-largest break-bulk facility) are staffed-guard-controlled at the truck gate as standard; classified true with medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long NW-SE cross-dock break-bulk building with a dense, regular rhythm of dock doors on both long faces; the ATL hub is cited in trucking forums as a ~304-door facility, firmly in the 50+ band. A second long narrow dock building sits to the east.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Vast paved trailer yard south and east of the cross-dock holds hundreds of parked trailers and pup trailers without tractors; firmly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot covers the majority of the property south/SE of the docks, full of parked trailers.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large paved yard and deep approach from the gate to the cross-dock provides ample room for a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Extensive paved yard width near the gate corridor gives physical room to add a dedicated bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound / 2 outbound lanes at the controlled gate; exact count not resolvable from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main cross-dock building, a 3-story office building at the NE end, and a second long dock building to the east = 3.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; classified false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter box (~813m x ~602m); large but consistent with one of the largest break-bulk hubs in the FedEx Freight network.
